## Tables

Here's a well-formed table, doing everything it should.

```````````````````````````````` example
| abc | def |
| --- | --- |
| ghi | jkl |
| mno | pqr |
.
Document scope=1:1..4:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..4:13 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=3
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="abc" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:8..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:9..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="def" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=2
    │   ├── TableRow scope=3:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="ghi" children=0
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=3:8..3:12 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │       └── Text scope=3:9..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="jkl" children=0
    │   └── TableRow scope=4:1..4:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=4:2..4:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=4:3..4:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="mno" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=4:8..4:12 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=4:9..4:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="pqr" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

We're going to mix up the table now; we'll demonstrate that inline formatting
works fine, but block elements don't.  You can also have empty cells, and the
textual alignment of the columns is shown to be irrelevant.

```````````````````````````````` example
Hello!

| _abc_ | セン |
| ----- | ---- |
| 1. Block elements inside cells don't work. | |
| But _**inline elements do**_. | x |

Hi!
.
Document scope=1:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Hello!" children=0
├── Table scope=3:1..6:37 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=3
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │       │   └── Emphasis scope=3:3..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │       └── Text scope=3:4..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="abc" children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=3:10..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=3:11..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="セン" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=2
│   │   ├── TableRow scope=5:1..5:48 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │   │   ├── TableCell scope=5:2..5:45 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │   │   │   └── Text scope=5:3..5:44 anchor=null attributes={} literal="1. Block elements inside cells don't work." children=0
│   │   │   └── TableCell scope=5:47..5:47 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
│   │   └── TableRow scope=6:1..6:37 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=6:2..6:32 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=3
│   │       │   ├── Text scope=6:3..6:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="But " children=0
│   │       │   ├── Emphasis scope=6:7..6:30 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │   │   └── Strong scope=6:8..6:29 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │   │       └── Text scope=6:10..6:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="inline elements do" children=0
│   │       │   └── Text scope=6:31..6:31 anchor=null attributes={} literal="." children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=6:34..6:36 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=6:35..6:35 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
│   └── TableFoot children=0
└── Paragraph scope=8:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=8:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Hi!" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Here we demonstrate some edge cases about what is and isn't a table.

```````````````````````````````` example
| Not enough table | to be considered table |

| Not enough table | to be considered table |
| Not enough table | to be considered table |

| Just enough table | to be considered table |
| ----------------- | ---------------------- |

| ---- | --- |

|x|
|-|

| xyz |
| --- |
.
Document scope=1:1..15:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| Not enough table | to be considered table |" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..4:45 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=3:1..3:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| Not enough table | to be considered table |" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=3:46..3:46 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=4:1..4:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| Not enough table | to be considered table |" children=0
├── Table scope=6:1..7:46 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=1
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=6:1..6:46 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=6:2..6:20 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │       │   └── Text scope=6:3..6:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Just enough table" children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=6:22..6:45 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=6:23..6:44 anchor=null attributes={} literal="to be considered table" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=0
│   └── TableFoot children=0
├── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=9:1..9:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| ---- | --- |" children=0
├── Table scope=11:1..12:3 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null] children=1
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=11:1..11:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       └── TableCell scope=11:2..11:2 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=11:2..11:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=0
│   └── TableFoot children=0
└── Table scope=14:1..15:7 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null] children=1
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=14:1..14:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=14:2..14:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=14:3..14:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="xyz" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

A "simpler" table, GFM style:

```````````````````````````````` example
abc | def
--- | ---
xyz | ghi
.
Document scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="abc" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:6..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="def" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:1..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="xyz" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:6..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:7..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="ghi" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

We are making the parser slighly more lax here. Here is a table with spaces at
the end:

```````````````````````````````` example
Hello!

| _abc_ | セン |
| ----- | ---- |
| this row has a space at the end | | 
| But _**inline elements do**_. | x |

Hi!
.
Document scope=1:1..8:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Hello!" children=0
├── Table scope=3:1..6:37 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=3
│   ├── TableHead children=1
│   │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:18 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │       │   └── Emphasis scope=3:3..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │       └── Text scope=3:4..3:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal="abc" children=0
│   │       └── TableCell scope=3:10..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │           └── Text scope=3:11..3:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="セン" children=0
│   ├── TableBody children=2
│   │   ├── TableRow scope=5:1..5:38 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   │   │   ├── TableCell scope=5:2..5:34 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
│   │   │   │   └── Text scope=5:3..5:33 anchor=null attributes={} literal="this row has a space at the end" children=0
│   │   │   └── TableCell scope=5:36..5:36 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
│   │   └── TableRow scope=6:1..6:37 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
````````````````````````````````

Table alignment:

```````````````````````````````` example
aaa | bbb | ccc | ddd | eee
:-- | --- | :-: | --- | --:
fff | ggg | hhh | iii | jjj
.
Document scope=1:1..3:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..3:27 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[left:null,none:null,center:null,none:null,right:null] children=2

    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:1..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="aaa" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:6..1:10 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bbb" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:12..1:16 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:13..1:15 anchor=null attributes={} literal="ccc" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:18..1:22 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:19..1:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="ddd" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:24..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:25..1:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="eee" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:27 anchor=null attributes={} children=5

````````````````````````````````

### Table cell count mismatches

The header and delimiter row must match.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b | c |
| --- | --- |
| this | isn't | okay |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=5
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| a | b | c |" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=1:14..1:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    ├── Text scope=2:1..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| --- | --- |" children=0
    ├── SoftBreak scope=2:14..2:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
    └── Text scope=3:1..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="| this | isn't | okay |" children=0
````````````````````````````````

But any of the body rows can be shorter. Rows longer
than the header are truncated.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b | c |
| --- | --- | ---
| x
| a | b
| 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
.
Document scope=1:1..5:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..5:21 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null,none:null] children=4
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:6..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:10..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:11..1:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=3
    │   ├── TableRow scope=3:1..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="x" children=0
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
    │   ├── TableRow scope=4:1..4:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=4:2..4:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=4:3..4:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=4:6..4:7 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=4:7..4:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=4:7..4:7 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
    │   └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:21 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    │       ├── TableCell scope=5:2..5:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=5:3..5:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="1" children=0
    │       ├── TableCell scope=5:6..5:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=5:7..5:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="2" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=5:10..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=5:11..5:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="3" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Embedded pipes

Tables with embedded pipes could be tricky.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b |
| --- | --- |
| Escaped pipes are \|okay\|. | Like \| this. |
| Within `\|code\| is okay` too. |
| _**`c\|`**_ \| complex
| don't **\_reparse\_**
.
Document scope=1:1..6:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..6:23 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=5
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:6..1:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:7..1:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=4
    │   ├── TableRow scope=3:1..3:47 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:30 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:29 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Escaped pipes are |okay|." children=0
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=3:32..3:46 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │   │       └── Text scope=3:33..3:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Like | this." children=0
    │   ├── TableRow scope=4:1..4:34 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=4:2..4:33 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=3
    │   │   │   ├── Text scope=4:3..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Within " children=0
    │   │   │   ├── Code scope=4:10..4:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="|code| is okay" children=0
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=4:28..4:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" too." children=0
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=4:34..4:34 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
    │   ├── TableRow scope=5:1..5:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │   │   ├── TableCell scope=5:2..5:24 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=2
    │   │   │   ├── Emphasis scope=5:3..5:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   │   │   │   └── Strong scope=5:4..5:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   │   │   │       └── Code scope=5:6..5:10 anchor=null attributes={} literal="c|" children=0
    │   │   │   └── Text scope=5:14..5:24 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" | complex" children=0
    │   │   └── TableCell scope=5:24..5:24 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
    │   └── TableRow scope=6:1..6:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=6:2..6:23 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=2
    │       │   ├── Text scope=6:3..6:8 anchor=null attributes={} literal="don't " children=0
    │       │   └── Strong scope=6:9..6:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=6:11..6:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="_reparse_" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=6:23..6:23 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Oddly-formatted markers

This shouldn't assert.

```````````````````````````````` example
| a |
--- |
.
Document scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Table scope=1:1..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null] children=1
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=1:1..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── TableCell scope=1:2..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=1:3..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

### Escaping

```````````````````````````````` example
| a | b |
| --- | --- |
| \\ | `\\` |
| \\\\ | `\\\\` |
| \_ | `\_` |
| \| | `\|` |
| \a | `\a` |

\\ `\\`

\\\\ `\\\\`

\_ `\_`

\| `\|`

\a `\a`
.
Document scope=1:1..17:7 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
├── Table scope=1:1..7:13 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=6
````````````````````````````````

### a table can be recognised when separated from a paragraph of text without an empty line

```````````````````````````````` example
123
456
| a | b |
| ---| --- |
d | e
.
Document scope=1:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="123" children=0
│   ├── SoftBreak scope=1:4..1:4 anchor=null attributes={} children=0
│   └── Text scope=2:1..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="456" children=0
└── Table scope=3:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=2
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=3:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=3:2..3:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=3:3..3:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=3:6..3:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=3:7..3:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=5:1..5:2 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=5:1..5:1 anchor=null attributes={} literal="d" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=5:4..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=5:5..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="e" children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

The lead a table is split out of is not a cell, so it is not pipe-unescaped:
an escaped backslash in front of a pipe stays an escaped backslash, and the
inline phase reads the escape the author wrote rather than one this extension
manufactured. Upstream disagrees and the difference is registered.

```````````````````````````````` example
pre \\| lead
| a | b |
| - | - |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:12 anchor=null attributes={} literal="pre \\| lead" children=0
└── Table scope=2:1..3:9 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=1
    ├── TableHead children=1
    │   └── TableRow scope=2:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
    │       ├── TableCell scope=2:2..2:4 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │       │   └── Text scope=2:3..2:3 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
    │       └── TableCell scope=2:6..2:8 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
    │           └── Text scope=2:7..2:7 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
    ├── TableBody children=0
    └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

The lead, the header row and its cells are all recovered from the paragraph's
content buffer, and an offset in that buffer is not a column. Inside a block
quote the two differ by the stripped prefix, so this is where reading one as
the other shows: every position below comes from the content-to-source map.

```````````````````````````````` example
> 123
> | a | b |
> | --- | --- |
.
Document scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Callout scope=1:1..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} variant=null collapsed=null children=2
    ├── Paragraph scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="123" children=0
    └── Table scope=2:3..3:15 anchor=null attributes={} columns=[none:null,none:null] children=1
        ├── TableHead children=1
        │   └── TableRow scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
        │       ├── TableCell scope=2:4..2:6 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
        │       │   └── Text scope=2:5..2:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="a" children=0
        │       └── TableCell scope=2:8..2:10 anchor=null attributes={} rowspan=1 colspan=1 children=1
        │           └── Text scope=2:9..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="b" children=0
        ├── TableBody children=0
        └── TableFoot children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Strikethroughs

A well-formed strikethrough.

```````````````````````````````` example
A proper ~strikethrough~.
.
Document scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Text scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="A proper " children=0
    ├── Strikethrough scope=1:10..1:24 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   └── Text scope=1:11..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="strikethrough" children=0
    └── Text scope=1:25..1:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal="." children=0
````````````````````````````````

Some strikethrough edge cases.

```````````````````````````````` example
These are ~not strikethroughs.

No, they are not~

This ~is ~ legit~ isn't ~ legit.

This is not ~~~~~one~~~~~ huge strikethrough.

~one~ ~~two~~ ~~~three~~~

No ~mismatch~~
.
Document scope=1:1..11:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=6
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:30 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=1:1..1:30 anchor=null attributes={} literal="These are ~not strikethroughs." children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=3:1..3:17 anchor=null attributes={} literal="No, they are not~" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:32 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Text scope=5:1..5:5 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This " children=0
│   ├── Strikethrough scope=5:6..5:17 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=5:7..5:16 anchor=null attributes={} literal="is ~ legit" children=0
│   └── Text scope=5:18..5:32 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" isn't ~ legit." children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:45 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=7:1..7:45 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This is not ~~~~~one~~~~~ huge strikethrough." children=0
├── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:25 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Strikethrough scope=9:1..9:5 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=9:2..9:4 anchor=null attributes={} literal="one" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=9:6..9:6 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   ├── Strikethrough scope=9:7..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=9:9..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="two" children=0
│   └── Text scope=9:14..9:25 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" ~~~three~~~" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=11:1..11:14 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    └── Text scope=11:1..11:14 anchor=null attributes={} literal="No ~mismatch~~" children=0
````````````````````````````````

Using 200 tilde since it overflows the internal buffer
size (100) for parsing delimiters in inlines.c
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~striked~

## Autolinks

```````````````````````````````` example
: http://google.com https://google.com

<http://google.com/å> http://google.com/å

scyther@pokemon.com

scy.the_rbe-edr+ill@pokemon.com

scyther@pokemon.com.

scyther@pokemon.com/

scyther@pokemon.com/beedrill@pokemon.com
.
Document scope=1:1..13:40 anchor=null attributes={} children=7
├── Paragraph scope=1:1..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} children=4
│   ├── Text scope=1:1..1:2 anchor=null attributes={} literal=": " children=0
│   ├── Link scope=1:3..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://google.com") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=1:3..1:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://google.com" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=1:20..1:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Link scope=1:21..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("https://google.com") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=1:21..1:38 anchor=null attributes={} literal="https://google.com" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=3:1..3:43 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
│   ├── Link scope=3:1..3:22 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://google.com/å") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=3:2..3:21 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://google.com/å" children=0
│   ├── Text scope=3:23..3:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" " children=0
│   └── Link scope=3:24..3:43 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("http://google.com/å") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=3:24..3:43 anchor=null attributes={} literal="http://google.com/å" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=5:1..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Link scope=5:1..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:scyther@pokemon.com") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=5:1..5:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="scyther@pokemon.com" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=7:1..7:31 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Link scope=7:1..7:31 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:scy.the_rbe-edr+ill@pokemon.com") title=null children=1
│       └── Text scope=7:1..7:31 anchor=null attributes={} literal="scy.the_rbe-edr+ill@pokemon.com" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=9:1..9:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Link scope=9:1..9:19 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:scyther@pokemon.com") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=9:1..9:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="scyther@pokemon.com" children=0
│   └── Text scope=9:20..9:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="." children=0
├── Paragraph scope=11:1..11:20 anchor=null attributes={} children=2
│   ├── Link scope=11:1..11:19 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:scyther@pokemon.com") title=null children=1
│   │   └── Text scope=11:1..11:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="scyther@pokemon.com" children=0
│   └── Text scope=11:20..11:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="/" children=0
└── Paragraph scope=13:1..13:40 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
    ├── Link scope=13:1..13:19 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:scyther@pokemon.com") title=null children=1
    │   └── Text scope=13:1..13:19 anchor=null attributes={} literal="scyther@pokemon.com" children=0
    ├── Text scope=13:20..13:20 anchor=null attributes={} literal="/" children=0
    └── Link scope=13:21..13:40 anchor=null attributes={} dest=url("mailto:beedrill@pokemon.com") title=null children=1
        └── Text scope=13:21..13:40 anchor=null attributes={} literal="beedrill@pokemon.com" children=0
````````````````````````````````

The `mailto:` and `xmpp:` forms collide with the dialect's text directive:
`:scyther` is also a valid directive name. The recognition order of
`docs/specs/dialect.md` puts the autolink scanner (A3) before the text
directive (A10), so the autolink scanner claims a colon that an address
follows before the directive scanner sees it, and every line below links
exactly as cmark-gfm links it; remark-directive, which would claim the
directive, is not the authority here.


## HTML tag filter


```````````````````````````````` example
This is <xmp> not okay, but **this** <strong>is</strong>.

<p>This is <xmp> not okay, but **this** <strong>is</strong>.</p>

Nope, I won't have <textarea>.

<p>No <textarea> here either.</p>

<p>This <random /> <thing> is okay</thing> though.</p>

Yep, <totally>okay</totally>.

<!-- HTML comments are okay, though. -->
<!- But we're strict. ->
<! No nonsense. >
<!-- Leave multiline comments the heck alone, though, okay?
Even with {"x":"y"} or 1 > 2 or whatever. Even **markdown**.
-->
<!--- Support everything CommonMark's parser does. -->
<!---->
<!--thistoo-->
.
````````````````````````````````

## Footnotes

```````````````````````````````` example

Here's a thing[^other-note].

And another thing[^codeblock-note].

This doesn't have a referent[^nope].

[^codeblock-note]:
        this is now a code block (8 spaces indentation)

[^1]: Some *bolded* footnote definition.

Hi!

[^footnote]:
    > Blockquotes can be in a footnote.

        as well as code blocks

    or, naturally, simple paragraphs.

[^unused]: This is unused.
.
````````````````````````````````

## When a footnote is used multiple times, we insert multiple backrefs.

```````````````````````````````` example
This is some text. It has a footnote[^a-footnote].

This footnote is referenced[^a-footnote] multiple times, in lots of different places.[^a-footnote]

[^a-footnote]: This footnote definition should have three backrefs.
.

│   │   └── Citation scope=1:38..1:48 referent=footnote(id="a-footnote") children=0

│   ├── Text scope=3:1..3:27 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This footnote is referenced" children=0

│   │   └── Citation scope=3:29..3:39 referent=footnote(id="a-footnote") children=0
│   │       ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│   │       └── CitationSuffix children=0
│   ├── Text scope=3:41..3:85 anchor=null attributes={} literal=" multiple times, in lots of different places." children=0
│   └── Cite scope=3:86..3:98 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│       └── Citation scope=3:87..3:97 referent=footnote(id="a-footnote") children=0
│           ├── CitationPrefix children=0
│           └── CitationSuffix children=0
└── Footnote scope=5:1..5:67 id="a-footnote" children=1
    └── Paragraph scope=5:16..5:67 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
        └── Text scope=5:16..5:67 anchor=null attributes={} literal="This footnote definition should have three backrefs." children=0
````````````````````````````````

## Interop

## Task lists

```````````````````````````````` example
- [ ] foo
- [x] bar
.
Document scope=1:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem scope=1:1..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
    │   └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       └── Text scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=2:1..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=2:7..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=2:7..2:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
````````````````````````````````

O5 recognizes the historical `[@]` controls below as custom tasks.
Both marker families retain the same nesting.

Show that a task list and a regular list get processed the same in
the way that sublists are created. If something works in a list
item, then it should work the same way with a task.  The only
difference should be the tasklist marker. So, if we use something
other than a space or x, it won't be recognized as a task item, and
so will be treated as a regular item.

```````````````````````````````` example
- [x] foo
  - [ ] bar
  - [x] baz
- [ ] bim

Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure
- [@] foo
  - [@] bar
  - [@] baz
- [@] bim
.
Document scope=1:1..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── List scope=1:1..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem scope=1:1..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=2
│   │   ├── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   │   └── Text scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
│   │   └── List scope=2:3..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
│   │       ├── ListItem scope=2:3..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
│   │       │   └── Paragraph scope=2:9..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │       └── Text scope=2:9..2:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
│   │       └── ListItem scope=3:3..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=1
│   │           └── Paragraph scope=3:9..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │               └── Text scope=3:9..3:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="baz" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=4:1..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=4:7..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=4:7..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bim" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=6:1..6:69 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=6:1..6:69 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure" children=0
└── List scope=7:1..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem scope=7:1..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=2
    │   ├── Paragraph scope=7:7..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=7:7..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
    │   └── List scope=8:3..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    │       ├── ListItem scope=8:3..8:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=1
    │       │   └── Paragraph scope=8:9..8:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=8:9..8:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
    │       └── ListItem scope=9:3..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=1
    │           └── Paragraph scope=9:9..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │               └── Text scope=9:9..9:11 anchor=null attributes={} literal="baz" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=10:1..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=10:7..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=10:7..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bim" children=0
````````````````````````````````
Use a larger indent -- a task list and a regular list should produce
the same structure.

```````````````````````````````` example
- [x] foo
    - [ ] bar
    - [x] baz
- [ ] bim

Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure
- [@] foo
    - [@] bar
    - [@] baz
- [@] bim
.
Document scope=1:1..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=3
├── List scope=1:1..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
│   ├── ListItem scope=1:1..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=2
│   │   ├── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │   │   └── Text scope=1:7..1:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
│   │   └── List scope=2:5..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
│   │       ├── ListItem scope=2:5..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
│   │       │   └── Paragraph scope=2:11..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │       │       └── Text scope=2:11..2:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
│   │       └── ListItem scope=3:5..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker="x" children=1
│   │           └── Paragraph scope=3:11..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   │               └── Text scope=3:11..3:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="baz" children=0
│   └── ListItem scope=4:1..5:0 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
│       └── Paragraph scope=4:7..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│           └── Text scope=4:7..4:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bim" children=0
├── Paragraph scope=6:1..6:69 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
│   └── Text scope=6:1..6:69 anchor=null attributes={} literal="Show a regular (non task) list to show that it has the same structure" children=0
└── List scope=7:1..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    ├── ListItem scope=7:1..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=2
    │   ├── Paragraph scope=7:7..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │   │   └── Text scope=7:7..7:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="foo" children=0
    │   └── List scope=8:5..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=2
    │       ├── ListItem scope=8:5..8:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=1
    │       │   └── Paragraph scope=8:11..8:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │       │       └── Text scope=8:11..8:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bar" children=0
    │       └── ListItem scope=9:5..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=1
    │           └── Paragraph scope=9:11..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
    │               └── Text scope=9:11..9:13 anchor=null attributes={} literal="baz" children=0
    └── ListItem scope=10:1..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} marker="@" children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=10:7..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=10:7..10:9 anchor=null attributes={} literal="bim" children=0
````````````````````````````````

A task item's checked state is decided by the marker the scanner matched, not
by a substring search over the line. `[x]` inside an unchecked item's own text
answers for the wrong bytes: this item is open and mentions a closed one.
cmark-gfm searches the line and reports it checked; that divergence is
registered as `tasklist-authored-marker`.

```````````````````````````````` example
- [ ] call me [x] later
.
Document scope=1:1..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
└── List scope=1:1..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} flavor=bullet start=null variant=null delimiter=null tight=true children=1
    └── ListItem scope=1:1..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} marker=" " children=1
        └── Paragraph scope=1:7..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} children=1
            └── Text scope=1:7..1:23 anchor=null attributes={} literal="call me [x] later" children=0
````````````````````````````````
